description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different relational association categories evaluated in the MMRA benchmark for large visual language models, with each slice representing a distinct relational type and its corresponding count and percentage of the total. The chart contains ten segments, each labeled with a relational category, its raw count, and its percentage contribution. The largest segment is “ObservationAngle” with 126 instances (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” at 106 (10.33%), and “SubEvent” and “UsageSimilarity” both at 100 (9.74% and 9.65%, respectively). Several categories — “SimilarEvent,” “AppearanceSimilarity,” “Environment,” and “Layout” — are tied at 90 instances each (8.77% each). “MentalitySimilarity” accounts for 89 instances (8.67%), “RelativePosition” for 81 (7.90%), and “NearSameEntity” is the smallest segment with 63 instances (6.34%). The segments are color-coded in varying shades of teal, brown, gray, and blue, and are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top. No slice is exploded or emphasized, and percentage values are displayed inside each segment for clarity.
